run_benchmark_comparison: run compare.py benchmarks to compare two benchmark JSON output files or executables side by side
run_filtered_comparison: run compare.py filters to compare two different filters from the same benchmark file
run_cross_benchmark_filtered_comparison: run compare.py benchmarksfiltered to compare a filter from one benchmark against a filter from another
run_comparison_with_utest: run compare.py with --alpha flag to set significance level for Mann-Whitney U statistical test
run_comparison_aggregates_only: run compare.py with -a flag to display only aggregate results when benchmarks have many repetitions
